name: Aphelion Halo Rim
core_rationale: Outermost high-altitude comet-drift ring of Continent 03 where Vesper's farthest gravity-anchors capture frost-coated star-shards at the edge of the twilight sky.
local_conflict: Rime-winged comet-drakes and astral-echoes circle the outer tether-buoys beyond the reach of standard sky-skiffs.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Star-navigators say the buoys along the Aphelion Halo Rim chime whenever a shooting star passes beneath the archipelago.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A distant outer ring of frost-silver basalt islets tethered by hair-thin threads of violet starlight.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What ancient celestial astrolabe is moored to the outermost buoy of the Aphelion Halo Rim?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater along the outermost orbital ring of Continent 03.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Frost-silver basalt islets moored to captured comet-shards by threads of violet starlight.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: starlight buoy-deck and wind-screen metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved as the outermost orbital District frontier on Continent 03 with zero filler maps.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook (in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, unanswered_question) and empty grid_nodes.
